name: Dense-grid to Voxlap-slab packing
definition: Converts a dense voxel mask and color grid of size VSID × VSID × MAXZDIM into the Voxlap slab-RLE column format. It seeds an all-solid VXL and carves air voxels using a column-function to preserve buried-voxel-aware encoding.
summary: Dense-grid to Voxlap-slab packing converts dense voxel grids into a slab-RLE format with explicit column offsets and direct color attachment, differing from other RLE methods by using a slab-based structure.
